title: 12. Above Average Major GPA
description: Find students whose GPA exceeds the overall university GPA average.
objective: Select name and gpa from Students for students with a GPA higher than the overall student average.
targetQuery: SELECT name, gpa FROM Students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM Students);
hint: Use a subquery: WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM Students)
